answers.brief_reasoning: A higher parking price lowers the quantity of parking demanded, which is a movement along the demand curve. Shoppers also switch to substitutes such as the bus. B describes supply, not demand. C says only the income effect, which ignores the substitution effect. D is wrong because no price ceiling is involved. E is wrong because the quantity of parking demanded does change.
